data.title: 盛夏防波堤的按帽海风
data.location: 海风拂过的白色防波堤栈桥
data.lighting: 明澈盛夏顶侧日光与海面反光
data.camera: 动态斜角海平线七分身

data.animaCaption: Holding her wide straw hat against a sudden sea gust with one hand, she leans toward you on the breakwater and offers a chilled glass ramune bottle with the other. Crisp summer sunlight and turquoise sea glare brighten her fluttering white shirt and yellow linen dress.
data.promptProse: Captured at a lively tilted angle along a sunlit concrete breakwater overlooking a glittering turquoise bay, Ayachi Nene wears a breezy pale-yellow linen sundress under an unbuttoned sheer white cover-up shirt and a ribboned wide-brim straw hat. A strong salt breeze whips her silver twin tails and white shirt tails sideways; she clamps one hand onto the crown of her hat while offering a beaded blue glass ramune bottle forward with a radiant, slightly squinting smile beneath towering white summer clouds and dazzling coastal sunlight.
data.story: 海风忽然把草帽吹得晃了一下。宁宁连忙抬手按住帽檐，任凭白色防晒衫被风鼓起衣摆，笑着把还挂着水珠的弹珠汽水贴到你脸颊上——「冰不冰？刚从栈桥那头的小店买回来，快趁凉喝一口！」
